rationale: For a Barangay Management System, the design needs to establish civic trust, authority, and clarity. Earthy green tones provide a professional government aesthetic while feeling approachable and grounded. The interface avoids a cold, clinical look by integrating warm neutrals and high-contrast earthy greens.

colors.description: Primary is a professional Forest Green (#2d6a4f). Backgrounds are tinted slightly warm-green to avoid sterile pure white. Muted and secondary tones use Sage/Mint for soft contrasts.

headings.instruction: Do not use Inter for headings. Keep headings sturdy and professional. H1 should not exceed text-4xl on desktop for dashboard views.

body.instruction: Clean, highly legible sans-serif for dense data tables and forms.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with p-6 or p-8 inside cards to allow data to breathe.
rules: Use sidebar navigation for the dashboard.
Cards must have a flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), and no default shadow.
Card hover state: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-md), border color darkens slightly.
For mobile, stack the grid (grid-cols-1) and hide sidebar behind a hamburger menu.
Use optical alignment for icons and text.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized to match the Organic & Earthy archetype.
components.buttons: Rounded-md, primary CTA uses primary green. Hover states must explicitly set text color (hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-white).
components.tables: Data dense but legible. Use left-alignment for text, right-alignment for numbers. Highlight active rows with subtle secondary background.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Inputs have 1px border. Focus states must use ring-primary.
components.cards: Subtle border-radius (rounded-lg or md). Avoid heavy shadows. Ensure padding is at least p-6 inside cards.

surface_styles.header: Crystal Glass variant: bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-border/50. Keeps navigation readable while scrolling.
surface_styles.dashboard_widgets: Neumorphism 'Tactile' variant with sharp 1px border to ground it, but mostly flat for cleanliness.

motion.interactions: Smooth transitions on all interactive elements. Example: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.hover: Hover states must have higher contrast.

image_urls.description: High-end architectural photography of a modern community center with earthy green tones.
Abstract geometric background with subtle green tones for hero/welcome widgets.
Professional asian portrait for user profile or resident avatars.
Professional confident asian portrait for barangay officials.
Elegant portrait for barangay chairman or main admin.
Green leaf minimal image to be used as a logo placeholder.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `@fontsource/work-sans` and `@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans` or include them in index.html.
Update tailwind.config.js to include font families 'Work Sans' and 'IBM Plex Sans'.
Update globals.css / index.css with the provided CSS variables.
Implement a responsive sidebar layout. Do not use generic Inter fonts for headings.
Ensure all data tables and grids use dense but well-padded layouts (Control Room Grid).
Use Shadcn UI components but strip away the default 'Vercel' look by applying our earthy color variables and flatter card styles.
For the login page, use the login_background image provided.
For the dashboard welcome card, use the dashboard_header_background.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
